items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: all I know the nickname was Wesley. And he left here.

ctx.x: Felt, boy, all I know the nickname was Wesley. And he left here. Another one, we call him Black Freddy. The other day, those fellas could play. You know, they used to come around, just come around and play.
Yeah, they had tipples and all kind of funny ukuleles, ain't it? 10-string, did you ever see a 10-string ukulele?
